pages.text: The zone with empty boxes takes up about 70% of the entire endless area, and unfortunately, that's the case. It's not very easy to move through this area, and at night, not-so-friendly guards appear here. There isn't much food, but there's quite a lot of water. There are also underground structures you should enter very carefully due to their danger.
On the surface, you can sometimes find small campsites. I don't even know who could have left them, but they work well enough as temporary shelters. Verdict-not the most pleasant place.
